gap: No result ChatGPT got gives named, measured numbers for the two boxes it recommends most. NASCompares (Rob Andrews, 2025-07-24) measured the Synology DS1825+ fully loaded with eight drives at 57–62 W idle, 35–38 dBA idle and 290–295 MB/s sequential read over one 2.5GbE port. NASCompares (2024-04-19) measured the UGREEN DXP8800 Plus at 650–700 MB/s over 10GbE, roughly 2.3× faster for media copies.
standout_why: I compared against the cited rival pages. ComputingForGeeks (cited, 2026-10-21) says it ran no tests of its own. It quotes ServeTheHome's TS-873A figures (26 W idle empty, 58 W max), so the TS-873A power numbers are already out there. For the DS1825+ and DXP8800 Plus it gives only maker power specs. Its measured throughput numbers are for the DXP8800 Ultra (from ITPro), not the Plus. WunderTech (cited, 2026-09-28) gives no numbers and only qualitative copy comparisons. Starry Hope's best-for-Plex page (cited, 2026-11-02) has measurements only for the DXP4800 Plus and DXP6800 Pro and does not mention the DS1825+ or TS-873A. TechRadar's Ultra-vs-Plus page shows no measured figures. None of them puts measured idle draw, idle noise or 2.5GbE-vs-10GbE throughput side by side for the DS1825+ and DXP8800 Plus. None mentions that the DS1825+ measured 35–38 dBA idle with drives, against Synology's 23.8 dB(A) spec.
decides: This confirms the DXP8800 Plus pick rather than changing it. A media library mostly means moving large files. Measured, the DS1825+ tops out near 290–295 MB/s on a single 2.5GbE link (about 580 MB/s peak with link aggregation). The DXP8800 Plus did 650–700 MB/s on 10GbE with no add-in card. Measured idle draw is about the same: 57–62 W for the DS1825+ with eight drives, and about 64–66 W for the DXP8800 Plus with ten drives (secondhand via Starry Hope). So power is not a reason to pick Synology. For a living-room shelf, the measured 35–38 dBA idle with eight drives is a better guide than the 23.8 dB(A) spec. The TS-873A's quiet figures (25 dBA idle, 31 dBA moderate) come from a 2021 test without a full set of drives, so they don't compare directly.
